subject: JAPN
title: Elementary Japanese I
scheduleNote: Freshmen, Sophomore or Junior status. Note: Japanese 201 is for those with no Japanese background. Students who have Japanese background or who have previously taken a course(s) in Japanese must take the Japanese Placement test.

subject: JAPN
title: Intermediate Japanese I
scheduleNote: Prerequisite: Japanese 202 or Placement Test for Students who have Japanese background or who have previously taken a course(s) in Japanese.

sections.sectionText: This course has a prerequisite: satisfactory completion of JAPN 202 or qualification by a placement test. Transfer students or students seeking to take it after a break of a year or more from their study of Japanese MUST take a placement test.

subject: JAPN
title: Advanced Japanese I
info: Prerequisite: JAPN 204 or placement test for students who have Japanese background or who have previously taken a course(s) in Japanese.

sections.sectionText: Call office for information on placement exam "Reading and Writing Section: The purpose of this course is to train students in academic reading and writing so that they can conduct research in Japanese. The course offers intensive reading and writing practices. Advanced knowledge of Kanji is required."
